preprocessing_motivation.normalization: Unicode NFKC, whitespace collapse, lowercasing, and contraction expansion (preserving negation) reduce surface sparsity.
preprocessing_motivation.tokenization: Alphanumeric token extraction cleanly separates punctuation while retaining banking terms (pin, atm, 2fa).
preprocessing_motivation.lemmatization: WordNet verb+noun lemmatization collapses inflectional variants (cards->card, charged->charge) to improve BoW generalization.
